artwork_method: Original editable SVG vectors; no AI raster generation and no external images or fonts. New counts and choice labels use self-contained Noto Sans CJK Bold glyph outlines (OFL), with no runtime font dependency.
alpha: Fully opaque normal and disabled buttons.
preview_scope: Offline BLP1-decoded 64px normal/disabled texture contact sheet. Not an in-game screenshot.
